subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A train line closed after a new high-speed route opened.”?
options: Students visiting the gate learned that it had once controlled who entered the old city.
A boy once brought a toy train that had not moved for two years.
The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.
Children who had never taken the old train learned where it once went.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students visiting the gate learned that it had once controlled who entered the old city.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A boy once brought a toy train that had not moved for two years.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The day after that, he talked with an old friend he met on the train.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Children who had never taken the old train learned where it once went.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Children who had never taken the old train learned where it once went.」，答案為「Children who had never taken the old train learned where it once went.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Children who had never taken the old train learned where it once went.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
